policy.candidates: The exact eight native child identities per parent in both complete locale responses; use existing GenerateFromCandidates uniformly and independent of format pools.
policy.magnetic: Native full Sparkbot bodies/keywords feed the ordinary magnetic merger and lifecycle; paired enchantment source records are evidence, not executable extra cards.
policy.end_turn: Meeting Stone declares ordinary own-controller EndTurnSpec and shares existing capture/repetition/continuation. Acquisition/burn uses ordinary AddToHand.

uncalibrated: Exact CN37 random distribution and event timing.
Individual token faces have not been separately verified against official API; complete source and primary parent child identities are retained.
